name: Cocolata
onCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends texlive-metapost libharfbuzz-bin opentype-sanitizer fontconfig inotify-tools && sudo rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
postCreateCommand: rustup default stable && curl -L --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cargo-bins/cargo-binstall/main/install-from-binstall-release.sh | bash && cargo-binstall -y fontc fontspector
